_about: Public-domain Minot Judson Savage (1841-1918), Unitarian minister of the Church of the Unity, Boston, and the Church of the Messiah, New York, for the Word Hoard: his books of sermons and religious argument, 1873-1905, from Christianity the Science of Manhood (1873) and The Religion of Evolution (1876) through Belief in God (1881), Beliefs about the Bible (1883), My Creed (1887) and Our Unitarian Gospel (1898) to Life Beyond Death (1899), The Passing and the Permanent in Religion (1901) and Life's Dark Problems (1905), with his books on psychical research. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 77 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
